notes.title: Update 1.06
notes.notes:
Tentikun's been decorating its pocket dimension. 
 You can now place lockers and doors in the pocket dimension to view your customized character and favorite animations.
 Fixed a problem with the evolution screen where some upgrades could not be reached. This change might require that you unlock some evolutions again.

notes.title: Update 1.05 - showers
notes.notes:
This update adds showers to the restroom. As with the toilet stalls you can leave one uninfected to view a different animation.

There is also now an option to toggle the camera's main angle while inside a "locker" to view from top-down. It can be useful in some situations.

notes.title: Update 1.04
notes.notes: Added option to turn off the camera auto-focusing on the selected/active locker while moving left/right in a stage.

notes.title: Update 1.03
notes.notes: Fixed a bug that could prevent some players from entering Tentikun's pocket dimension.

notes.title: Update 1.02
notes.notes:
Improved translations for Korean, Japanese, and Chinese.
 Fixed bug related to unlocking achievements.
 Fixed bug where correct music was not always playing,
 Improved pod skin in pocket dimension.

notes.title: Update 1.01
notes.notes: Added translations for Chinese, Japanese, and Korean.

notes.title: Update 1.00 - pocket dimension
notes.notes:
V1.0 of Tentikun is now available. This update adds new evolutions to unlock, including Tentikun’s pocket dimension.

Unlock Tentikun’s pocket dimension, then break the seal on the male restroom and infect it with a portal to a dimension where Tentikun gets to play with its own harem.

Unlock new love pods and grow the harem capacity via evolution points on the evolution screen.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43826973/63c20f096cef4d3474d6ef1a021f988a51db13fc.jpg

Customize the girls to your liking by changing their hair style, eye and face shape, breast size, and skin, hair, and eye colour.

Choose which pods to use and insert the girls to have some fun with them. You can choose to insert or remove tentacles and the speed of the action.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43826973/d8d18b66beb72c19cbd0bef1c2e3b11f1acd7769.jpg

notes.title: Update 0.200 - restroom unlocked
notes.notes:
Tentikun can now learn how to break the seal on sealed doors. This will allow you to recover lockers sealed by officers or to break into sealed areas like the newly added female restroom.

Tip: Do not infect all the toilet stall. Wait for a character to enter one and then use the normal action key to spy on them.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43826973/29c40e5f9d3131465b12a9a227ba07088e2e464d.jpg

Update Notes:

 Tentikun can learn how to break seals.
 Tentikun can enter the female restroom by breaking the seal on the door.
 New options available in settings panel to tweak the features you want to see.
 Officers are more resistant to being grabbed and might seal the locker trying to grab them.
 Added system for characters to interact with features in the stage. This will be expanded on in future updates.
 Various fixes and updates to existing features.
 Added more music.

notes.title: Update 0.114
notes.notes: This update fixes more problems that were causing some players to be stuck in the loading screen.

notes.title: Update 0.113
notes.notes: This patch fixes a bug which slipped through concerning older save files which became invalid.

notes.title: Update 0.111
notes.notes: This patch fixes a problem that could occur on the evolution screen, showing icons unlocked from a previous session in a new session.

notes.title: Update 0.110
notes.notes: This update adds more animation sets to the closet and elevators.

notes.title: Update 0.109
notes.notes: This patch should resolve issues with save files that bacame invalid, leading to endless loading.

notes.title: Update 0.108
notes.notes:
The Elevators are now available for infection.
 Added new animation sets.
 Added gfx quality options to disabled features for lower-end devices and better performance on those devices
 The alert bar is now decreased by 5 (previously 1) during each recovery tick (which is currently between around 30 to 60 seconds depending on upgraded state)

notes.title: Update 0.105
notes.notes: Tentikun can now infect the broom/wall closet. This will allow you to grab one to three characters at the same time. Note that this is a special location that can only be infected with a love pod; no auto-pod for example.
